value.rationale: Directly closes a motivated logical gap in the original literature between variational stationarity and an established global minimum, extends it to smooth potentials with reversible speed measure, and provides exact competitor regret and equality/stability information. The exponential drift benchmark gives a natural closed-form control design. It is a structural all-clock theorem rather than a recomputation of a known rate optimum.
